refinements.descriptionEn: Increases CRIT Rate by 15%. When the equipper deals DMG with a Basic Attack or EX Special Attack, they gain 1 stack of a buff. Each stack increases the equipper's Electric DMG by 12.5%, up to 2 stacks. Each stack lasts 40s. The duration of each stack is calculated separately. Can trigger once per use of a skill. At 2 stacks, the wearer's Basic Attack and Ultimate DMG ignore 20% of enemy DEF.

basic.trigger: 点按 【普通攻击键】 发动：
basic.description:
点按 【普通攻击键】 发动：

basic.descriptionEn:
Press [Basic Attack] to activate:
Perform up to 4 attacks forward, dealing Physical DMG for the first two hits and Electric DMG for the third and fourth hits.
When attacked between the retreat of the 3rd hit to before the 4th hit, triggers an automatic dodge.

special.descriptionEn:

Throw a steel wheel that traces a curved path, dealing Electric DMG.

ex.name: 强化特殊技：铁萼雨幕
ex.nameEn: EX Special Attack: Raining Iron Petals
ex.trigger: 能量足够时，点按 【强化特殊技键】 发动：
ex.triggerEn: With enough Energy, press [EX Special Attack] to activate:
ex.description:
能量足够时，点按 【强化特殊技键】 发动：
进入飞行模式，可进行四向移动，连续发射弹幕对敌人造成大量电属性伤害；

飞行期间，松开 【强化特殊技键】 可发动[强化特殊技：铁萼雨幕·离]；
一次飞行消耗60点能量时，自动发动[普通攻击：落华·重戮]；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
ex.descriptionEn:
With enough Energy, press [EX Special Attack] to activate:
Enter flight mode, where Seed can move in four directions, and unleash a continuous barrage of missiles, dealing massive Electric DMG.
Hold [EX Special Attack] to extend the barrage duration while continuously consuming Energy.
During flight, release [EX Special Attack] to trigger EX Special Attack: Raining Iron Petals - Away.
Upon consuming 60 Energy points in one flight, automatically trigger Basic Attack: Falling Petals - Slaughter.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

facts.text:
「席德」将初始攻击力最高的[强攻]队友视为[正兵]；
[正兵]释放[强化特殊技]时，使「席德」获得[强袭]状态，提升「席德」1000点攻击力和30%暴击伤害，「席德」释放[强化特殊技]时，使[正兵]获得[明攻]状态，提升[正兵]1000点攻击力和30%暴击伤害；
[明攻][强袭]同时存在时，「席德」与[正兵]同时获得[围杀]状态，造成的伤害提升25%；
[强袭]，[明攻]与[围杀]的增益效果可在角色为当前操作中角色时生效，角色切换为非当前操作角色时，增益效果依然生效，直到角色退场或增益效果维持3秒后，增益效果失效，角色切换为当前操作角色时，重新使增益效果生效；
进入战场时若存在[正兵]，「席德」立刻获得[强袭]与[围杀]状态，[正兵]立刻获得[明攻]与[围杀]状态；
[明攻]与[强袭]状态持续40秒，重复获得刷新持续时间；
[正兵]作为操作中角色消耗能量时或「席德」消耗能量时，每消耗1点能量，可为「席德」回复0.5点[钢能]。
facts.textEn:
The Attack teammate with the highest initial ATK is considered Seed's Vanguard.
When the Vanguard unleashes an EX Special Attack, Seed gains Onslaught status, increasing Seed's ATK by 1,000 and CRIT DMG by 30%. When Seed unleashes an EX Special Attack, the Vanguard gains Direct Strike status, increasing the Vanguard's ATK by 1,000 and CRIT DMG by 30%.
When Direct Strike and Onslaught are both active, Seed and the Vanguard simultaneously gain Besiege status, increasing DMG dealt by 25%.
Onslaught, Direct Strike, and Besiege buffs can all take effect when the character is the current active character. When switching to inactive, the buffs remain until the character goes off-field or 3s after the switch. When the character returns to being the active character, the buffs re-activate.
Upon entering the battlefield with a Vanguard, Seed immediately gains Onslaught status and Besiege status, while the Vanguard immediately gains Direct Strike status and Besiege status.
Direct Strike and Onslaught status last for 40s, and repeated triggers refresh the duration.
When the Vanguard consumes Energy as the active character or when Seed consumes Energy, for every 1 point of Energy consumed, Seed recovers 0.5 points of Steel Charge.

cinema.name: 「冻眠期」
cinema.description: 「席德」[钢能]达到100点时，即可发动[普通攻击：落华·崩坠]且总计消耗的[钢能]降低至100点；获得一次快速释放[普通攻击：落华·重戮]机会所需的[钢能]降低至100点；进入战场/发动[终结技]时，额外累积40/20点[钢能]；[普通攻击：落华·崩坠]造成的暴击伤害提升30%。
cinema.descriptionEn: When Seed's Steel Charge reaches 100, Basic Attack: Falling Petals - Downfall can be triggered, and the total Steel Charge consumed is reduced to 100. The amount of Steel Charge required to gain one chance to quickly release Basic Attack: Falling Petals - Slaughter is reduced to 100. Accumulate an additional 40/20 Steel Charge when entering the battlefield/using Ultimate. Increases Basic Attack: Falling Petals - Downfall CRIT DMG by 30%.

cinema.name: 「汲光法」
cinema.description: 代理人[围杀]状态的增益效果生效时，该代理人造成的伤害无视20%防御力；发动[强化特殊技：铁萼雨幕]时，在累计消耗60点能量后，可继续消耗能量延长招式，直到松开按键或累计消耗120点能量；[强化特殊技：铁萼雨幕]每消耗5点能量会使本次衔接的[普通攻击：落华·重戮]造成的伤害提升5%。
cinema.descriptionEn: When Besiege is active for an Agent, that Agent's DMG ignores 20% of DEF. When activating EX Special Attack: Raining Iron Petals, after consuming a total of 60 Energy, Seed can continue consuming Energy to extend the duration of the skill until the button is released or a total of 120 Energy is consumed. For every 5 Energy consumed by EX Special Attack: Raining Iron Petals, the following Basic Attack: Falling Petals - Slaughter's DMG increases by 5%.

basic.descriptionEn:
After the 4th hit of a Basic Attack, Dodge Counter, Quick Assist, or Assist Follow-Up, hold or press [Basic Attack] to activate:
Summon the mech to perform a charged punch attack, dealing massive Electric DMG.
When Steel Charge reaches 120, gain one chance to quickly activate Basic Attack: Falling Petals - Slaughter by holding [Basic Attack]. This effect expires when Steel Charge is less than 120 or after using the method above to activate Basic Attack: Falling Petals - Slaughter once.
Does not accumulate Steel Charge on hit.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

basic.name: 普通攻击：落华·崩坠
basic.description:
「席德」拥有[钢能]值，自身招式命中敌人可累积[钢能]；
[钢能]最大150点，初始拥有60点[钢能]，达到120点时，在[普通攻击：落华·重戮]或[终结技：机芯花园·绽放！]发动后，可点按或长按 【普通攻击键】  消耗60点[钢能]释放[普通攻击：落华·崩坠一式]，并自动消耗60点[钢能]衔接发动[普通攻击：落华·崩坠二式]；
操控机甲，扫射并释放强力跳砸，造成大量电属性伤害；
命中敌人时不累积[钢能]；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
basic.descriptionEn:
Seed has Steel Charge, which she can accumulate by hitting enemies with her skills.
Steel Charge has a maximum value of 150, and an initial value of 60. Upon reaching 120 Steel Charge and triggering Basic Attack: Falling Petals - Slaughter or Ultimate: Clockwork Garden - Bloom!, press or hold [Basic Attack] to consume 60 Steel Charge and unleash Basic Attack: Falling Petals - Downfall First Form, then automatically consume 60 Steel Charge to follow up with Basic Attack: Falling Petals - Downfall Second Form.
Pilots the mech to fire sweeping shots and perform a jumping smash, dealing massive Electric DMG.
Does not accumulate Steel Charge on hit.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

basic.name: 冲刺攻击：磁陨轮舞
basic.description:
闪避时，点按 【普通攻击键】 发动：
向前方扔出钢轮，造成物理伤害。
basic.descriptionEn:
Press [Basic Attack] during a dodge to activate:
Throw steel wheels forward, dealing Physical DMG.

ex.name: 特殊技：苍霜零落
ex.description:
点按 【特殊技键】 发动：
扔出钢轮，划出曲线轨迹造成电属性伤害。
ex.descriptionEn:
Press [Special Attack] to activate:
Throw a steel wheel that traces a curved path, dealing Electric DMG.

ex.name: 强化特殊技：铁萼雨幕
ex.nameEn: EX Special Attack: Raining Iron Petals
ex.description:
能量足够时，点按 【强化特殊技键】 发动：
进入飞行模式，可进行四向移动，连续发射弹幕对敌人造成大量电属性伤害；
长按 【强化特殊技键】 可以延长弹幕发射时间并持续消耗能量；
飞行期间，松开 【强化特殊技键】 可发动[强化特殊技：铁萼雨幕·离]；
一次飞行消耗60点能量时，自动发动[普通攻击：落华·重戮]；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
ex.descriptionEn:
With enough Energy, press [EX Special Attack] to activate:
Enter flight mode, where Seed can move in four directions, and unleash a continuous barrage of missiles, dealing massive Electric DMG.
Hold [EX Special Attack] to extend the barrage duration while continuously consuming Energy.
During flight, release [EX Special Attack] to trigger EX Special Attack: Raining Iron Petals - Away.
Upon consuming 60 Energy points in one flight, automatically trigger Basic Attack: Falling Petals - Slaughter.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

ex.name: 强化特殊技：铁萼雨幕·离
ex.nameEn: EX Special Attack: Raining Iron Petals - Away
ex.description:
[强化特殊技：铁萼雨幕]发动期间，松开 【强化特殊技键】 发动：
释放快速的炮击，造成电属性伤害；
命中敌人时不累积[钢能]；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
ex.descriptionEn:
During EX Special Attack: Raining Iron Petals, release [EX Special Attack] to activate:
Unleash rapid cannon fire, dealing Electric DMG.
Does not accumulate Steel Charge on hit.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

ultimate.name: 终结技：机芯花园·绽放！
ultimate.description:
喧响等级达到[极]时，点按 【终结技键】 发动：
亲自驾驭机甲，倾泻出大量导弹与流星般的致命光弹，并释放强力跳砸，造成大量电属性伤害；
招式发动后，累积60点[钢能]；
命中敌人时不累积[钢能]；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
ultimate.descriptionEn:
When Decibel Rating is at Maximum, press [Ultimate] to activate:
Seed will pilot the mech personally, raining down missiles and a meteor shower of rockets, then performing a jumping smash, dealing massive Electric DMG.
After using this skill, accumulate 60 Steel Charge.
Does not accumulate Steel Charge on hit.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

quickAssist.name: 快速支援：花雨齐射
quickAssist.nameEn: Quick Assist: Barrage of Raining Flowers
quickAssist.description:
当前操作中的角色被击飞时，点按 【切换键】 发动：
对前方敌人发动连续的激光打击，造成电属性伤害；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
quickAssist.descriptionEn:
When the active character is launched, press [Switch] to activate:
Unleash a barrage of lasers at enemies in front, dealing Electric DMG.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

146100001.name: 普通攻击：霜蕊轮舞
146100001.description:
点按 【普通攻击键】 发动：
向前方进行至多四段的攻击，前两段造成物理伤害，第三第四段造成电属性伤害；
第三段后撤动作至第四段攻击发动前受到攻击，可触发自动闪避。
146100001.descriptionEn:
Press [Basic Attack] to activate:
Perform up to 4 attacks forward, dealing Physical DMG for the first two hits and Electric DMG for the third and fourth hits.
When attacked between the retreat of the 3rd hit to before the 4th hit, triggers an automatic dodge.

146100002.name: 普通攻击：落华·重戮
146100002.description:
[普通攻击]第四段、[闪避反击]、[快速支援]、[支援突击]后，可通过长按或点按 【普通攻击键】  发动：
召唤机甲，进行蓄力冲拳攻击，造成大量电属性伤害；
[钢能]值达到120点时，可获得一次快速释放[普通攻击：落华·重戮]的机会，长按 【普通攻击键】 直接发动；[钢能]值不足120点或通过上述方式发动一次[普通攻击：落华·重戮]后，该效果移除；
命中敌人时不累积[钢能]；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
146100002.descriptionEn:
After the 4th hit of a Basic Attack, Dodge Counter, Quick Assist, or Assist Follow-Up, hold or press [Basic Attack] to activate:
